text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, what should I even say...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm frustrated. It's so frustrating that 
it's difficult to even remain standing 
like this, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, please let me praise you for 
now. ...Congratulations, Spe-chan."
—And Special Week took a step toward me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight... the strength for 
every step toward the finish line came 
from you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much... for believing in me 
and cheering me on!

And Special Week smiled, looking very 
proud of herself...
